metadata.article_title: The Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the Council of States

article.title: The Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the Council of States
article.content:
89The Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the Council of States
              



Article 89 · Part V · Officers of Parliament


(1)The Vice-President of India shall be ex officio Chairman of the Council of
                States.

(2)The Council of States shall, as soon as may be, choose a member of the
                Council to be Deputy Chairman thereof and, so often as the office of Deputy Chairman becomes vacant, the
                Council shall choose another member to be Deputy Chairman thereof.
